This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ExposureMode defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

1_ExposureMode ExposureModeCode for the mechanism by which the exposure agent was exchanged or potentially exchanged by the participants involved in the exposure.trueactive
2  AIRBORNE airborne**Description:** Communication of an agent from a living subject or environmental source to a living subject through indirect contact via oral or nasal inhalation.active
2  CONTACT contact**Description:** Communication of an agent from a living subject or environmental source to a living subject through direct physical contact.active
2  FOODBORNE foodborne**Description:** Communication of an agent from a food source to a living subject via oral consumption.active
2  WATERBORNE waterborne**Description:** Communication of an agent to a living subject by contact and/or consumption via an aqueous mediumactive
